==== role=serve invocation=Combined scope=User ====
#!/bin/sh
# Auto-generated by `iroh-tunnel service install` — do not edit by hand.
# BusyBox/SysV init script for iroh-tunnel (serve).

DAEMON='/opt/iroh tunnel/bin/iroh-tunnel'
ROLE=serve
CONFIG='/home/a b/it'\''s & <cfg>/serve $x%i.toml'
export IROH_TUNNEL_STATE_DIR='/var/lib/iroh $state%n'
PIDFILE=/var/run/iroh-tunnel-serve.pid
LOG=/var/log/iroh-tunnel-serve.log
PROC=/proc

# The PID file: the daemon's PID, then the launched DAEMON path and a `.`
# sentinel (so trailing characters of the path survive `$(...)`). A file
# with no second line was written by an earlier script (legacy).
SEP=$(printf '\001')

read_pidfile() {
    PID=$(head -n 1 "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)
    REC=$(tail -n +2 "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)
    REC=${REC%.}
}

# $1 the process's exe, $2 the expected path: equal, or replaced on disk.
exe_matches() {
    [ -n "$2" ] && { [ "$1" = "$2" ] || [ "$1" = "$2 (deleted)" ]; }
}

# A legacy PID file: 0 = the current DAEMON, or an iroh-tunnel executable
# running this role with this config; 1 = another process; 2 = unreadable.
legacy_match() {
    exe_matches "$1" "$DAEMON" && return 0
    NAME=${1%" (deleted)"}; NAME=${NAME##*/}
    case "$NAME" in iroh-tunnel*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    CMD=$(tr '\000' '\001' 2>/dev/null < "$PROC/$PID/cmdline") || return 2
    TAIL="${SEP}run${SEP}--config$SEP$CONFIG$SEP"
    case "$CMD" in
        *"$SEP$ROLE$TAIL") return 0 ;;
        *"$TAIL") [ "$NAME" = "iroh-tunnel-$ROLE" ] && return 0 ;;
    esac
    return 1
}

# Whether the PID file names the daemon: 0 = ours, 1 = stale (no file, no
# such process, a zombie, or another executable), 2 = unverifiable (an
# unreadable PID file, or a live process whose executable cannot be read).
identity() {
    [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] || return 1
    [ -r "$PIDFILE" ] || return 2
    read_pidfile
    case "$PID" in ''|0*|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        # Alive but not ours to signal (EPERM), or dead.
        [ -e "$PROC/$PID" ] && return 2
        return 1
    fi
    [ -e "$PROC/$PID" ] || return 2
    # A zombie (state `Z` after the last ") " of its stat) holds nothing.
    ST=$(cat "$PROC/$PID/stat" 2>/dev/null) && case ${ST##*") "} in Z*) return 1 ;; esac
    EXE=$(readlink "$PROC/$PID/exe" 2>/dev/null) || return 2
    if [ -n "$REC" ]; then
        exe_matches "$EXE" "$REC"
        return
    fi
    legacy_match "$EXE"
}

unverifiable() {
    echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE): cannot verify that pid $PID is the daemon; $PIDFILE kept" >&2
}

start() {
    identity
    case $? in
        0) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) already running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        2) unverifiable; return 1 ;;
    esac
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    echo "Starting iroh-tunnel ($ROLE)"
    "$DAEMON" "$ROLE" run --config "$CONFIG" >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
    printf '%s\n%s.' "$!" "$DAEMON" > "$PIDFILE"
}

stop() {
    identity
    case $? in
        2) unverifiable; return 1 ;;
        0)
            echo "Stopping iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) (pid $PID)"
            kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null
            # Give iroh-tunnel up to 5s to drain on SIGTERM, then force-kill
            # only if the PID still runs the daemon.
            i=0
            while [ "$i" -lt 5 ] && identity; do
                sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
            done
            if identity; then kill -KILL "$PID" 2>/dev/null; fi
            ;;
    esac
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
}

status() {
    identity
    case $? in
        0) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) is running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        2) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) status unknown: cannot verify pid $PID"; return 4 ;;
    esac
    echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) is not running"
    return 3
}

case "$1" in
    start) start ;;
    stop) stop ;;
    restart) stop && start ;;
    status) status ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
exit $?

    NAME=${1%" (deleted)"}; NAME=${NAME##*/}
    case "$NAME" in iroh-tunnel*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    CMD=$(tr '\000' '\001' 2>/dev/null < "$PROC/$PID/cmdline") || return 2
    TAIL="${SEP}run${SEP}--config$SEP$CONFIG$SEP"
    case "$CMD" in
        *"$SEP$ROLE$TAIL") return 0 ;;
        *"$TAIL") [ "$NAME" = "iroh-tunnel-$ROLE" ] && return 0 ;;
    esac
    return 1
}

# Whether the PID file names the daemon: 0 = ours, 1 = stale (no file, no
# such process, a zombie, or another executable), 2 = unverifiable (an
# unreadable PID file, or a live process whose executable cannot be read).
identity() {
    [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] || return 1
    [ -r "$PIDFILE" ] || return 2
    read_pidfile
    case "$PID" in ''|0*|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        # Alive but not ours to signal (EPERM), or dead.
        [ -e "$PROC/$PID" ] && return 2
        return 1
    fi
    [ -e "$PROC/$PID" ] || return 2
    # A zombie (state `Z` after the last ") " of its stat) holds nothing.
    ST=$(cat "$PROC/$PID/stat" 2>/dev/null) && case ${ST##*") "} in Z*) return 1 ;; esac
    EXE=$(readlink "$PROC/$PID/exe" 2>/dev/null) || return 2
    if [ -n "$REC" ]; then
        exe_matches "$EXE" "$REC"
        return
    fi
    legacy_match "$EXE"
}

unverifiable() {
    echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE): cannot verify that pid $PID is the daemon; $PIDFILE kept" >&2
}

start() {
    identity
    case $? in
        0) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) already running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        2) unverifiable; return 1 ;;
    esac
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    echo "Starting iroh-tunnel ($ROLE)"
    "$DAEMON" "$ROLE" run --config "$CONFIG" >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
    printf '%s\n%s.' "$!" "$DAEMON" > "$PIDFILE"
}

stop() {
    identity
    case $? in
        2) unverifiable; return 1 ;;
        0)
            echo "Stopping iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) (pid $PID)"
            kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null
            # Give iroh-tunnel up to 5s to drain on SIGTERM, then force-kill
            # only if the PID still runs the daemon.
            i=0
            while [ "$i" -lt 5 ] && identity; do
                sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
            done
            if identity; then kill -KILL "$PID" 2>/dev/null; fi
            ;;
    esac
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
}

status() {
    identity
    case $? in
        0) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) is running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        2) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) status unknown: cannot verify pid $PID"; return 4 ;;
    esac
    echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) is not running"
    return 3
}

case "$1" in
    start) start ;;
    stop) stop ;;
    restart) stop && start ;;
    status) status ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
exit $?
==== role=access invocation=Standalone scope=User ====
#!/bin/sh
# Auto-generated by `iroh-tunnel service install` — do not edit by hand.
# BusyBox/SysV init script for iroh-tunnel (access).

DAEMON='/opt/iroh tunnel/bin/iroh-tunnel'
ROLE=access
CONFIG='/home/a b/it'\''s & <cfg>/access $x%i.toml'
export IROH_TUNNEL_STATE_DIR='/var/lib/iroh $state%n'
PIDFILE=/var/run/iroh-tunnel-access.pid
LOG=/var/log/iroh-tunnel-access.log
PROC=/proc

# The PID file: the daemon's PID, then the launched DAEMON path and a `.`
# sentinel (so trailing characters of the path survive `$(...)`). A file
# with no second line was written by an earlier script (legacy).
SEP=$(printf '\001')

read_pidfile() {
    PID=$(head -n 1 "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)
    REC=$(tail -n +2 "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)
    REC=${REC%.}
}

# $1 the process's exe, $2 the expected path: equal, or replaced on disk.
exe_matches() {
    [ -n "$2" ] && { [ "$1" = "$2" ] || [ "$1" = "$2 (deleted)" ]; }
}

# A legacy PID file: 0 = the current DAEMON, or an iroh-tunnel executable
# running this role with this config; 1 = another process; 2 = unreadable.
legacy_match() {
    exe_matches "$1" "$DAEMON" && return 0
    NAME=${1%" (deleted)"}; NAME=${NAME##*/}
    case "$NAME" in iroh-tunnel*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    CMD=$(tr '\000' '\001' 2>/dev/null < "$PROC/$PID/cmdline") || return 2
    TAIL="${SEP}run${SEP}--config$SEP$CONFIG$SEP"
    case "$CMD" in
        *"$SEP$ROLE$TAIL") return 0 ;;
        *"$TAIL") [ "$NAME" = "iroh-tunnel-$ROLE" ] && return 0 ;;
    esac
    return 1
}

# Whether the PID file names the daemon: 0 = ours, 1 = stale (no file, no
# such process, a zombie, or another executable), 2 = unverifiable (an
# unreadable PID file, or a live process whose executable cannot be read).
identity() {

    case "$PID" in ''|0*|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        # Alive but not ours to signal (EPERM), or dead.
        [ -e "$PROC/$PID" ] && return 2
        return 1
    fi
    [ -e "$PROC/$PID" ] || return 2
    # A zombie (state `Z` after the last ") " of its stat) holds nothing.
    ST=$(cat "$PROC/$PID/stat" 2>/dev/null) && case ${ST##*") "} in Z*) return 1 ;; esac
    EXE=$(readlink "$PROC/$PID/exe" 2>/dev/null) || return 2
    if [ -n "$REC" ]; then
        exe_matches "$EXE" "$REC"
        return
    fi
    legacy_match "$EXE"
}

unverifiable() {
    echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE): cannot verify that pid $PID is the daemon; $PIDFILE kept" >&2
}

start() {
    identity
    case $? in
        0) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) already running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        2) unverifiable; return 1 ;;
    esac
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    echo "Starting iroh-tunnel ($ROLE)"
    "$DAEMON" run --config "$CONFIG" >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
    printf '%s\n%s.' "$!" "$DAEMON" > "$PIDFILE"
}

stop() {
    identity
    case $? in
        2) unverifiable; return 1 ;;
        0)
            echo "Stopping iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) (pid $PID)"
            kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null
            # Give iroh-tunnel up to 5s to drain on SIGTERM, then force-kill
            # only if the PID still runs the daemon.

                sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
            done

    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
}

status() {
    identity
    case $? in
        0) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) is running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        2) echo "iroh-tunnel ($ROLE) status unknown: cannot verify pid $PID"; return 4 ;;
    esac

    return 3

case "$1" in
    start) start ;;
    stop) stop ;;
    restart) stop && start ;;
    status) status ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
exit $?
==== role=access invocation=Standalone scope=System ====
#!/bin/sh
# Auto-generated by `iroh-tunnel service install` — do not edit by hand.

ROLE=access
CONFIG='/home/a b/it'\''s & <cfg>/access $x%i.toml'
export IROH_TUNNEL_STATE_DIR='/var/lib/iroh $state%n'
# iroh-tunnel-pin config=/home/a%20b/it%27s%20%26%20%3Ccfg%3E/access%20%24x%25i.toml uid=1000
export IROH_TUNNEL_TRUSTED_UID=1000
PIDFILE=/var/run/iroh-tunnel-access.pid
LOG=/var/log/iroh-tunnel-access.log
PROC=/proc
